references.text: Describes the same rules regarding the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that is waved, which the priest shall receive as his portion from the sacrifice.
Aaron waved the breast and the right thigh as a wave offering before the Lord, just as Moses had commanded.
Refers to the consecration of the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that is waved as an eternal right for the priests.
The priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram and place it in the hands of the Nazirite along with the wave offering.
Confirms that the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh belong to the priests as an eternal right.
The rights of the priests from the people include the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach from the sacrificial animals.
Describes the fat that shall be burned on the altar as a food offering to the Lord.
